search_result_count_definition: Sum of requested numResults across all web_search_exa calls; not a count of documents read in full.
scope_statement: Curated primary-source research seed for India education funding, covering six funding channels. This does not claim exhaustive NGO, document, city, state or live funding-availability coverage.

search_workstreams.query: Official Ministry of Corporate Affairs India National CSR data portal education spending state district financial year corporate social responsibility project company education school college
search_workstreams.objective: Prioritize MCA/CSR government portal and official disclosures; identify geography, reporting period and education classifications, avoid unofficial totals.

search_workstreams.query: Official FCRA Ministry Home Affairs India foreign contribution NGO annual return FC-4 donor education purposes district state 2024 2025
search_workstreams.objective: Prioritize official FCRA reporting portal and NGO filed annual returns; distinguish registration eligibility from actual receipts and allocations.

search_workstreams.query: World Bank ADB India school higher education financing STARS MERITE project official state allocation loan 2025 2024
search_workstreams.objective: Prioritize official World Bank and ADB project pages or press releases; collect commitment amount, project identity and geographic coverage, not assumptions of disbursement.

search_workstreams.query: Pratham Educate Girls Akshaya Patra annual report audited financial statements 2024 2025 funding government schools donor districts India
search_workstreams.objective: Find NGO primary annual report pages and financial disclosures; record provenance and coverage without representing total available NGOs.

search_workstreams.query: KKR Lighthouse Learning education India schools investment official press release equity service company 2024 2025
search_workstreams.objective: Find primary investor or company press releases explaining private education investment and school group structure; distinguish private equity from school grants.

search_workstreams.query: India higher education university philanthropy endowment scholarships Tata Trusts Azim Premji Foundation HDFC education CSR annual report official 2024 2025
search_workstreams.objective: Prioritize official foundation and company reports documenting school/college scholarships, education grant funding and programme geography.

panel_round_1: Model money as events with amount, currency/unit, fiscal period, status, donor, intermediary, recipient, geography precision and source evidence; do not sum announced, committed, released and spent.

Separate public budget, CSR, philanthropy, FCRA foreign grants, multilateral sovereign loans and private equity. A school-support service company is a different entity from a regulated school institution.
Show national/state/city source scope explicitly; a filter for every state can still show no locally verified records, never fabricated zero funding.
De-duplicate government-to-NGO and corporate-to-NGO pass-through funding; retain transaction chain rather than treating both disclosures as new money.
Anomaly cards must say investigation signal, show counter-hypotheses and require matched periods, boundaries and school-management types before comparing closures with population.
Use source document date, fiscal period and retrieval date separately; annual report upload path is not publication date.
Provide drill-through original URLs, disclosure limitations and exportable rows. Hide summed funding KPI where categories are not comparable.
panel_round_2_challenges: Reject all-NGO/all-city coverage claims: MCA and FCRA registries supply discovery, but many records lack project geography; build explicit coverage matrix with local evidence vs national context.
Foreign investment transaction amounts absent from primary announcement stay null even when news articles give estimates.
CSR board report precedence and grouped education/livelihood categorization must appear in methodology and data validation.
School closures plus rising total population does not establish wrongdoing: compare school-age cohorts, ward/catchment, enrollment, migration, private transfer and merged-school service/access.
Do not infer grant applications are currently open from annual reports. Distinguish historical funding evidence from actionable calls for applications.
coverage_gaps: No current full MCA project export downloaded; dynamic selection/captcha encountered.
No comprehensive education-only FCRA donor/recipient census or project-location allocation.
No current ADB primary project source vetted in this workstream.
No city funding totals established from the primary source set.
Private school fee revenue, bank lending, endowments and government-aided institution grant ledgers need additional institution-level evidence.
NGO programmes and investor examples are illustrative, not exhaustive.
primary_fetch_method: Exa page extraction; large reports capped at 16,000 characters in initial fetches. Relevant extracted sections supporting listed claims reviewed; reports were not read cover-to-cover.
